heading: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana Taxation: Decoding SSY's EEE Status
tldr: The Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) offers a triple tax benefit, commonly known as the Exempt-Exempt-Exempt (EEE) status.
Contributions made to an SSY account are eligible for deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, up to ₹1.5 lakh annually.
The interest earned on the SSY account is entirely tax-exempt, accumulating free of tax throughout the investment period.
The maturity amount received from the SSY account is also completely tax-free in the hands of the beneficiary.
Parents should be aware of the annual deposit limits and the specific conditions for premature withdrawals and final maturity to maximise benefits.
caption:
Want to secure your daughter's financial future and save on taxes? The Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) offers a fantastic triple tax benefit – meaning you save tax when you put money in, while it grows, and when you take it out! It's a simple way to build a tax-free fund for her education or wedding. Learn all the details about how SSY can benefit you and your daughter in our latest article.
